en.seoTitle: Orca: Parallel Coding Agents, Worktrees, and Review Loops
en.description: Orca brings multiple coding agents into one workspace, with separate Git worktrees and a shared review interface. Study task isolation, parallel comparisons, and diff feedback to organize agent work without confusing simultaneous execution with a verified result.
overview: Orca is a development workspace published in stablyai/orca. It organizes existing coding agents such as Codex, Claude Code, OpenCode, and Pi alongside terminals, repository files, and review tools. It coordinates agent processes rather than supplying a new foundation model.

Each parallel task can use its own Git worktree. That separates file changes while the workspace provides a place to inspect diffs and send feedback. A mobile companion and SSH workflows extend how work is monitored or executed, but model access and remote-environment setup remain separate requirements.

For a Floatboat workflow, the useful pattern is to define bounded assignments, isolate changes, and compare evidence before accepting an implementation. Parallel agents still need a shared task contract and an explicit integration owner. Running in separate worktrees does not itself prevent mistakes, conflicts, or unauthorized actions.
en.capabilitiesTitle: Coordinate Independent Attempts and Review Their Results
en.capabilitiesIntro: Orca separates file isolation, review before integration, and observation across environments. Compare those responsibilities when coordinating agents, with clear task ownership and shared checks so parallel execution does not obscure who decides which changes enter the final result.

capabilities.title: Isolate file changes by task
capabilities.description: Assign worktrees to bounded tasks or competing approaches, so one agent does not silently overwrite another agent’s uncommitted files.

capabilities.title: Review changes before integration
capabilities.description: Use diffs and line-level comments to turn review findings into focused follow-ups, then inspect the revised result.

capabilities.title: Observe work across environments
capabilities.description: Desktop, companion, and SSH interfaces support different monitoring or execution arrangements. Choose the one that fits the actual environment.

useCases.title: Use Cases for Orca
useCases.description: Competing implementations, independent review, and parallel repository edits need comparable baselines. Explore Orca's coordination patterns through fixed revisions, isolated worktrees, and shared acceptance checks, with ownership and final integration decisions defined before work begins.

items.title: Compare two implementation approaches
items.description: Two implementation approaches are comparable only when they receive the same requirement and tests. Keep the attempts in isolated branches, then assess behavior, complexity, and verification evidence side by side. The fastest completion should not outweigh a result that better meets the shared acceptance conditions.

items.title: Separate implementation from review
items.description: Separate implementation from review with a fixed handoff revision and explicit acceptance conditions. Give the reviewer that code baseline and a focused question, then connect each finding and resolution to the revision being considered. This prevents review comments from drifting onto code that changed after the assessment began.

items.title: Work on distinct repository areas
items.description: Parallel repository work needs separable ownership boundaries, shared-interface rules, and an integration owner. Allocate worktrees or branches by those boundaries and agree on merge order before changes overlap. Joint checks at integration should verify that individually valid contributions still work together.

items.title: Keep a failed parallel attempt bounded
items.description: One agent's unsuccessful change should be assessed within its assigned files and revision rather than allowed to disturb unrelated work. Compare the branch result with the task brief, retain useful evidence, and decide separately whether to revise, defer, or discard that attempt. Use Orca's worktree coordination as a reference while keeping engine permissions and final integration decisions explicit.

faq.question: Which Orca project does this page describe?
faq.answer: The source is stablyai/orca, the high-star multi-agent development workspace. Other repositories named Orca are separate projects and should not be used as interchangeable installation sources.

faq.question: Does Orca replace Codex or Claude Code?
faq.answer: It organizes existing coding agents in a shared workbench. The selected engines still perform the model-driven work and retain their own account requirements.

faq.question: Do separate worktrees make parallel work safe automatically?
faq.answer: They isolate working files, but do not provide a complete security boundary or resolve shared-interface conflicts. Define permissions, task scope, and integration checks separately.

faq.question: Can agents use different models or providers?
faq.answer: The project supports multiple CLI agent engines. Exact models, quotas, and authentication depend on the selected engine and account.

faq.question: What is the mobile app for?
faq.answer: The documented companion lets a user monitor and steer work associated with a desktop host. It does not mean every provider engine runs directly on the phone.

faq.question: Should every task be sent to several agents?
faq.answer: No. Use parallel attempts when independent work or comparison is valuable. Shared mutable work and unclear acceptance criteria can add coordination cost without improving the result.

prerequisites.title: Prepare Orca engines and remote access
prerequisites.description: Each agent engine needs its own installation, authentication, and execution policy checked. Review remote or companion access separately from worktree isolation: independent file branches do not provide provider subscriptions or a security boundary for the processes running within them.

items.title: Confirm each agent’s setup
items.description: Install and authenticate the engines you intend to use. Source availability does not include provider subscriptions or unlimited model usage.

items.title: Inspect execution and remote access
items.description: Review the chosen engine’s approval settings and any SSH or companion connection. A worktree is file isolation, not a security boundary.

howTo.title: Integrate one reviewed Orca result
howTo.description: Parallel changes need more than individual agent completion before they can be combined. Review the proposed revisions, test the accepted set together, and make a separate merge decision so integration evidence reflects the actual version that would enter the repository.

items.title: Integrate one reviewed result
items.description: Choose the accepted change, run checks on the combined revision, and keep the merge decision explicit rather than equating task completion with approval.

en.seoDescription: Coordinate coding agents in separate worktrees with Orca. Compare their changes, review findings, and feed bounded follow-up tasks back into the development workflow.

zh.seoTitle: Orca：并行编程 Agent、独立 Worktree 与审阅循环
zh.description: Orca 将多个编程 Agent 放进同一工作台，通过独立 Git worktree 和统一审阅界面组织任务。了解任务隔离、并行方案比较与 diff 反馈，为自己的工作流明确执行分工和最终验收。
zh.kind: 多 Agent 开发工作台
overview: Orca 是 stablyai/orca 发布的开发工作台，将 Codex、Claude Code、OpenCode、Pi 等已有编程 Agent 与终端、仓库文件和审阅工具组织在一起。它协调 Agent 进程，不提供新的基础模型。
并行任务可以使用各自的 Git worktree 隔离文件修改，再通过工作台查看 diff 并发送反馈。移动端伴侣与 SSH 工作流扩展了观察或执行工作的方式，但模型访问和远程环境准备仍是独立条件。
在 Floatboat 中设计工作流时，可以借鉴有边界的任务分派、修改隔离与结果比较。并行 Agent 仍需共同的任务约定和明确的集成负责人；仅使用不同 worktree，并不能自动避免错误、冲突或越权操作。
zh.capabilitiesTitle: 组织独立尝试，再审阅结果
zh.capabilitiesIntro: 文件隔离、工作观察和集成前审阅，分别回答 Orca 协作中的不同问题。任务由谁负责、结果按什么标准检查以及最终是否接受变更，都需要在并行执行之外保持明确。

capabilities.title: 按任务隔离文件修改
capabilities.description: 为独立任务或不同方案安排 worktree，避免一个 Agent 无意覆盖另一个 Agent 尚未提交的文件。

capabilities.title: 集成前检查实际修改
capabilities.description: 通过 diff 和行内评论把审阅发现转成明确的后续任务，再检查修订后的结果。

capabilities.title: 按环境选择观察入口
capabilities.description: 桌面、伴侣和 SSH 界面承担不同的监控与执行安排，应按实际环境选择。

useCases.title: Orca的使用场景
useCases.description: 独立方案需要相同测试才可比较，单独审阅需要固定版本，并行修改还要有集成负责人。Orca 的协调方式可供借鉴，让工作区、共同检查和最终接受决定保持对应。

items.title: 比较两种实现方案
items.description: 比较两种实现方案时，使用相同需求和测试，并将两次尝试放在隔离分支中。并排检查行为、复杂度和验证证据，让判断基于共同验收条件。完成速度可以作为观察项，但不能代替对结果正确性和维护成本的比较。

items.title: 分开实施与代码审阅
items.description: 将实施和审阅分开时，明确交接版本与验收条件。向审阅者提供固定代码基线和具体问题，并将每条发现及处理结果关联到该版本。这样可以避免审阅过程中代码继续变化，导致评论和实际接受的修改不再对应。

items.title: 并行处理不同仓库区域
items.description: 并行修改仓库时，需要可分离的责任范围、共享接口规则和最终集成负责人。按这些边界分配工作区或分支，并提前约定合并顺序。集成阶段进行联合检查，确认各自成立的修改放在一起之后仍然能够正常协作。

items.title: 限定失败的并行尝试范围
items.description: 某个 Agent 的修改没有成功时，应在分配给它的文件与版本范围内评估，不影响其他无关工作。将分支结果与任务说明比较，保留有用证据，再分别决定修订、暂缓还是放弃。参考 Orca 的工作区协调时，仍需明确引擎权限和最终集成决定。

faq.question: 这里介绍的是哪个 Orca？
faq.answer: 采用的是高 stars、多 Agent 开发工作台 stablyai/orca。同名仓库属于不同项目，不能作为可互换的安装来源。

faq.question: Orca 会替代 Codex 或 Claude Code 吗？
faq.answer: 它把现有编程 Agent 组织进共同工作台，实际模型任务仍由所选引擎执行，并沿用各自的账号条件。

faq.question: 使用不同 worktree 就自动安全吗？
faq.answer: 它们隔离工作文件，但不是完整安全边界，也不会自动解决共享接口冲突。权限、任务范围与集成检查仍需单独设计。

faq.question: 不同 Agent 可以用不同模型吗？
faq.answer: 项目支持多个 CLI Agent 引擎，具体模型、配额与认证方式取决于对应引擎和账号。

faq.question: 移动端应用负责什么？
faq.answer: 文档中的伴侣应用用于观察和跟进桌面宿主上的工作，不代表所有供应方引擎都直接运行在手机上。

faq.question: 是否应该把每项任务都发给多个 Agent？
faq.answer: 不需要。独立工作或方案比较有价值时才适合并行；共享修改和不清晰的验收标准可能增加协调成本。

prerequisites.title: 准备 Orca 引擎与远程访问
prerequisites.description: 每个 Agent 引擎都需要核对安装、认证与执行策略。以下条件将远程或伴随连接与工作区隔离分开；独立文件分支不提供服务订阅，也不构成进程运行的安全边界。

items.title: 确认每个 Agent 的运行条件
items.description: 安装并登录计划使用的引擎，源码公开不包含供应方订阅或无限模型额度。

items.title: 检查执行与远程访问设置
items.description: 核对所选引擎的审批模式，以及 SSH 或伴侣连接；worktree 隔离文件，但不构成安全隔离。

howTo.title: 整合一项审阅后的 Orca 结果
howTo.description: 各 Agent 分别完成，并不能证明组合后的代码仍然正确。先审阅拟议版本，再将已认可修改放入同一集成版本测试，最后单独决定合并，使证据对应实际进入仓库的结果。

items.title: 集成经过审阅的结果
items.description: 选择接受的修改后，对组合版本运行检查，并保留明确的合并决定，不能把任务完成等同于获准发布。

zh.seoDescription: 用 Orca 在独立 worktree 中组织并行编程 Agent，比较各自修改并审查问题，将发现转成范围明确的后续任务；了解隔离执行、结果整合与人工判断的分工。

en.seoTitle: NVIDIA Auto Ontology: Semantic Layer for Auditable Text-to-SQL
en.seoDescription: NVIDIA Auto Ontology maps business terms and reviewed metric SQL to database tables. Inspect generated queries and returned rows through read-only MCP.
en.description: NVIDIA Auto Ontology maps business terms, metrics, and table relationships to database evidence so agents can answer questions with SQL you can inspect.
en.overviewTitle: How NVIDIA Auto Ontology grounds database questions
overview: A question about revenue can be ambiguous even when the database is well documented. The agent needs to know which revenue definition applies, which tables can be joined, and which records to exclude. Auto Ontology compiles database metadata into a semantic layer that maps business terms to columns and relationships and can hold reviewed SQL for measures.

The project runs alongside the databases. Its chat interface can return the SQL, rows and steps behind an answer. Its read-only MCP server also exposes term lookup, answerability checks and questions to authenticated clients under the signed-in user's permissions. The companion setup, management and query Skills guide a coding agent through those operations.

When designing a Floatboat workflow for periodic reporting, use the ontology as a pattern for giving metrics an owner, a definition and a reproducible query. Start with a small test database and compare each result to an analyst-approved reference before treating the workflow as a source for decisions.
en.capabilitiesTitle: What Auto Ontology exposes to an agent
en.capabilitiesIntro: Follow a business question from the term it matched to the SQL and rows it produced. That gives an analyst separate places to check coverage, join logic and the underlying records.

capabilities.title: Business terms and reviewed measures
capabilities.description: Map terms to columns and attach reviewed SQL to measures whose business definitions need to be consistent.

capabilities.title: Relationships and query evidence
capabilities.description: Follow table relationships, inspect the generated SQL and compare the returned rows with a known result.

capabilities.title: Read-only MCP access
capabilities.description: Search terms and check whether a question is answerable before issuing it through a separately deployed, authenticated MCP server.

useCases.title: NVIDIA Auto Ontology use cases
useCases.description: Start with a question whose expected answer an analyst can reproduce. Use the SQL and rows to diagnose whether a mismatch comes from the definition, the join, the time window, or the underlying source.

items.title: Resolve two definitions of revenue
items.description: If finance reports net revenue and sales reports booked revenue, document the exclusions and approved query for each. Test the same monthly request against both measures and make the reporting agent surface the definition it selected.

items.title: Check joins before publishing a weekly KPI
items.description: Compare the generated order-to-invoice join against reference SQL using orders with multiple invoice lines. Review row counts and totals together so a plausible-looking aggregate does not hide duplicate records.

items.title: Route unsupported questions for review
items.description: Include a region or product attribute missing from the ontology in an evaluation set. Check answerability before asking for SQL, and capture the missing mapping for an analyst instead of filling the report with a guess.

items.title: Keep a reporting decision reproducible
items.description: Save the time window, approved measure, SQL and returned rows beside the result. When a source schema or definition changes, rerun the original question and give reviewers evidence for any difference.

prerequisites.title: What a test deployment needs
prerequisites.description: The upstream quickstart uses Microsoft’s Wide World Importers sample. Its Docker Compose configuration runs the supporting services, while the configured inference endpoints and credentials are managed separately.

items.title: Local runtime
items.description: Install Docker with Compose v2 and uv for the upstream sample setup.

items.title: Model endpoint access
items.description: Set the credentials for your configured inference endpoints. The documented sample quickstart uses an NVIDIA API key.

items.title: Database scope
items.description: Start with the sample database or an approved test source and restrict the credentials to the data needed for the task.

faq.question: What does the ontology store?
faq.answer: It connects business terms, columns, table relationships and SQL definitions. The underlying records stay in the connected data sources.

faq.question: Which SQL has been reviewed, and which SQL do I still need to check?
faq.answer: A data owner can review the SQL attached to a measure. The query generated for a particular question still needs to be checked against the requested time window, joins and returned rows.

faq.question: Can an MCP client change my ontology?
faq.answer: The upstream MCP server exposes read-only tools. Authenticate with the deployment and review its account permissions before testing.

faq.question: What if a metric is missing?
faq.answer: Use the answerability tools to identify missing coverage and ask a data owner to define or approve the metric before using it in reporting.

faq.question: What are the NVIDIA ontology Skills for?
faq.answer: They guide setup, semantic model management and validated querying. The query workflow depends on a running Auto Ontology deployment.

faq.question: Does the sample setup need model credentials?
faq.answer: Yes. NVIDIA documents an API key for the sample quickstart. Check the model endpoint and credential requirements when changing the configuration.

zh.seoTitle: NVIDIA Auto Ontology：企业数据语义层与可核验的文本转 SQL
zh.seoDescription: NVIDIA Auto Ontology 将业务术语、指标定义和表关系交给 Agent。用示例库核对生成的 SQL、返回行和连接条件，并查看只读 MCP 怎样判断问题是否在语义层的覆盖范围内。
zh.description: NVIDIA Auto Ontology 把业务术语、指标口径和表关系映射到数据库，让 Agent 回答数据问题时给出可以核对的 SQL。
zh.overviewTitle: NVIDIA Auto Ontology 如何为数据库问答提供依据
overview: 同一句“上个月收入是多少”，财务和销售可能采用不同口径。Agent 要先理解收入的定义、哪些表可以连接，以及哪些记录应排除。Auto Ontology 从数据库元数据编译语义层，将术语映射到列与表关系，并可为指标保存审核过的 SQL。
项目部署在数据库旁。聊天界面可以返回答案背后的 SQL、结果行和执行步骤；只读 MCP 服务还向已认证的客户端提供术语查询、可回答性检查和问答工具，调用遵循登录用户的权限。配套的三个 Skills 分别覆盖部署、语义模型管理和查询验证。
如果在 Floatboat 里设计定期报表，可以借鉴这套方法，为指标保存责任人、定义和可复跑查询。先在测试库里选几个分析师可以独立复算的问题，把结果逐项核对清楚，再决定哪些指标可以交给 Agent。
zh.capabilitiesTitle: Auto Ontology 给 Agent 提供哪些数据依据
zh.capabilitiesIntro: 业务问题先对应到术语和指标定义，再沿表关系生成查询。比对 SQL 与返回行时，可以把口径、连接条件和数据质量分开排查。

capabilities.title: 业务术语与指标口径
capabilities.description: 将术语映射到实际字段，为需要统一定义的度量绑定审核过的 SQL。

capabilities.title: 表关系与查询证据
capabilities.description: 查看查询经过哪些表及连接条件，并将返回行与已知结果对照。

capabilities.title: 只读 MCP 工具
capabilities.description: 通过独立部署并完成认证后，可以先查术语和可回答性，再执行有依据的数据问答。

useCases.title: NVIDIA Auto Ontology 的使用场景
useCases.description: 选一个分析师可以独立复算的问题，固定数据快照与统计周期。若结果有出入，先查指标定义，再查表连接和返回行，避免多个变量同时变化。

items.title: 对齐财务与销售的收入口径
items.description: 财务可能按净收入统计，销售则关注已签订单金额。分别记录两个指标的计算口径、排除项和参考 SQL，再对同一个月复算，并在报表标出实际采用的指标。

items.title: 检查关联查询是否重复计数
items.description: 选取包含多行发票明细的订单，比较生成查询与人工确认的订单到发票连接。先核对行数，再核对汇总金额，避免误把重复记录算进周报。

items.title: 将缺少定义的问题交回分析师
items.description: 在评估集中加入语义层没有覆盖的地区或产品属性，查询前先检查是否可回答。记录缺失的字段映射，由数据负责人补齐后再生成指标。

items.title: 为定期报表留下复核材料
items.description: 把统计区间、指标定义、实际 SQL 与返回行随报表存档。数据库字段或定义调整后重跑相同问题，审阅人可以追查数字变化从何而来。

prerequisites.title: 运行示例前要准备什么
prerequisites.description: 官方示例使用微软的 Wide World Importers 数据库。Docker Compose 启动配套服务，推理端点和凭据则按选用的模型单独配置。

items.title: 本地运行环境
items.description: 按上游快速入门准备 Docker、Compose v2 和 uv。

items.title: 推理端点凭据
items.description: 为所选推理端点配置凭据。上游示例使用 NVIDIA API 密钥。

items.title: 测试数据范围
items.description: 先使用示例库或获准的测试数据源，并将数据库账号限制在任务所需范围内。

faq.question: 本体层里保存了什么？
faq.answer: 保存业务术语、字段映射、表关系和指标的 SQL 定义。实际记录仍存放在连接的数据源中。

faq.question: 哪些 SQL 已经过审核，哪些还需要自己核对？
faq.answer: 数据负责人可以审核指标关联的 SQL 定义。针对某个问题生成的实际查询仍要核对统计周期、表连接与返回行，再和参考结果比较。

faq.question: MCP 客户端可以修改本体吗？
faq.answer: 上游 MCP 提供只读工具。连接需要经过部署实例认证，测试前可核对该账户的数据权限。

faq.question: 语义层没有覆盖我的指标怎么办？
faq.answer: 先检查问题是否可回答，找出缺少的术语、字段或定义。由指标负责人确认后再把结果用于报表。

faq.question: 三个 NVIDIA Ontology Skills 分别做什么？
faq.answer: 分别指导部署、语义模型管理和验证查询。执行查询前需要可用的 Auto Ontology 实例。

faq.question: 运行官方示例需要模型凭据吗？
faq.answer: 需要。上游快速入门使用 NVIDIA API 密钥，改用其他端点时需核对相应的认证配置。

en.seoTitle: Craft Anything: Software Inspection and AI Rebuild Checks
en.seoDescription: Capture visible behavior with Craft Anything and brief a coding agent. Compare rebuilt websites across screen widths and check early-alpha and Deep mode limits.
en.description: Craft Anything collects evidence from software you are allowed to study, passes a brief to a coding agent, and compares the new implementation against the reference.
en.overviewTitle: From software observation to a testable rebuild
overview: A screenshot captures one moment. It leaves out mobile layouts, open menus and the behavior that makes a prototype useful. Craft Anything is an early-alpha Rust project that records observations and puts them alongside a new implementation and its comparison results. The desktop app, CLI and MCP interface expose the same underlying engine.

The default clean-room mode studies visible behavior, such as text, screenshots, spacing and menu states. Deep mode can inspect internals such as files or code when you are authorized to examine them. The mode does not isolate the operating system, and a coding agent still acts with its own permissions.

The useful pattern for a Floatboat workflow is to turn observable evidence into a brief and a set of acceptance checks. Choose assets and interactions you have permission to reuse, keep references separate from generated files, and record differences you want to fix or keep.
en.capabilitiesTitle: How Craft Anything connects evidence and implementation
en.capabilitiesIntro: The project folder separates the capture, new implementation, and comparison results. Those artifacts make it possible to revisit one mismatch without reopening every design choice.

capabilities.title: Capture visible states
capabilities.description: Record pages at several widths, visible text, layout measurements and open controls to specify what the new project needs to do.

capabilities.title: Delegate the build
capabilities.description: Give an installed coding agent a brief and target stack. Upstream documents Claude Code as the first supported builder.

capabilities.title: Compare the result
capabilities.description: Review viewport checks and remaining mismatches against the source evidence, then decide which differences need another pass.

useCases.title: Craft Anything use cases
useCases.description: Choose a target you can examine and a small set of behaviors worth reproducing. The handoff should identify what was observed, where the brief leaves room for judgment, and how to evaluate the result.

items.title: Replace an internal page with a responsive prototype
items.description: Capture the current layout at desktop, tablet and phone widths, including a collapsed navigation state. Ask the builder to use your own copy and assets, then check overflow, element order and menu behavior at all three widths.

items.title: Document the behavior of a retiring desktop tool
items.description: Work from a permitted copy and record how the window changes after an import, an empty file or a failed action. Turn the observations into acceptance cases for a replacement and list any behavior you could not reproduce.

items.title: Rebuild a game mechanic as a small experiment
items.description: Choose a mechanic you may study, such as a movement or scoring loop, and describe it using your own art and level design. Treat a runnable demo and a repeatable gameplay check as the handoff, with unresolved differences listed separately.

items.title: Separate regressions from approved design changes
items.description: After reviewing a comparison, approve the intentional differences in writing and turn the rest into small fix requests. Rerun the affected checks so later reviewers can tell a deliberate redesign from an unresolved mismatch.

prerequisites.title: What to prepare before a Craft Anything run
prerequisites.description: Start with a target you are authorized to inspect and a separate project folder. Confirm your platform’s release and your coding agent before committing to a larger rebuild.

items.title: A reference you may study
items.description: Define what can be captured and what assets, copy or branding require separate permission.

items.title: A build agent for implementation
items.description: Check the supported backend in the upstream status notes. Claude Code uses its own local installation and sign-in.

items.title: A testable project scope
items.description: Pick representative screens or states and write down how you will compare them. Early-alpha support varies by target and tool.

faq.question: What can the default clean-room mode see?
faq.answer: It uses visible evidence such as screenshots, text and measured layout. Deep mode is separate and may inspect internals where you have permission.

faq.question: Does clean-room mode sandbox the builder?
faq.answer: The mode controls what Craft Anything offers for inspection. The operating system and coding agent keep their own permission boundaries.

faq.question: Is Craft Anything ready for production migration?
faq.answer: Upstream labels it early alpha. Pilot with a bounded target and verify the particular platform, agent and comparison tools you intend to rely on.

faq.question: Can I inspect a project without starting a build?
faq.answer: Yes. The upstream app provides an inspection-only path in Deep mode, and the CLI and MCP interfaces expose inspection tools.

faq.question: Can I use Codex as the builder?
faq.answer: Upstream documents a Codex adapter but says it has not verified it on a real installation. Check the current status before depending on it.

faq.question: Does the source license cover the target’s assets?
faq.answer: Craft Anything is offered under MIT or Apache-2.0. A target's logos, text, images and other materials keep their own rights.

zh.seoTitle: Craft Anything：软件界面取证、AI 重建与差异验收
zh.seoDescription: Craft Anything 从获准研究的软件记录界面与交互，交给编程 Agent 重建，并对照重建网页在不同屏宽下的表现。项目处于早期 Alpha，Deep 模式的内部检查需要单独确认权限。
zh.description: Craft Anything 从获准研究的软件采集界面与行为证据，把任务交给编程 Agent，再将新的实现与参考对象逐项比较。
zh.overviewTitle: 把软件观察结果变成可验收的重建任务
overview: 一张截图只记录某一刻的界面，无法说明窄屏怎样排版、菜单怎样展开，或导入失败后出现什么。Craft Anything 是早期 Alpha 的 Rust 项目，将观察记录、新实现和对照结果放在同一项目里。桌面应用、CLI 和 MCP 共用底层引擎。
默认的洁净室模式从可见行为取证，例如截图、文字、间距和展开的菜单。Deep 模式可以进一步查看文件或代码等内部信息，前提是你有权查看。模式本身不会隔离操作系统，编程 Agent 仍使用自己的读写和执行权限。
在 Floatboat 里构建类似工作流时，可以把观察记录整理成任务书和验收项。选用有权使用的素材和交互，将参考资料与生成文件分开，逐条标明哪些差异要修、哪些可以保留。
zh.capabilitiesTitle: Craft Anything 如何把观察结果交给编程 Agent
zh.capabilitiesIntro: 项目目录分别保存观察记录、新实现和对照结果。遇到界面差异时，可以回到原始截图、布局尺寸或交互状态，决定是修正实现还是保留设计调整。

capabilities.title: 记录多个界面状态
capabilities.description: 保存不同屏宽下的页面、可见文字、布局尺寸与控件展开状态，为重建说明补上单张截图遗漏的细节。

capabilities.title: 将实现交给编程 Agent
capabilities.description: 提供任务说明和目标技术栈，由本机编程 Agent 生成项目。上游首先支持 Claude Code。

capabilities.title: 用对照结果决定下一轮修改
capabilities.description: 检查各屏宽下的结果与原参考之间还有哪些差异，再决定需要修改的交互或布局。

useCases.title: Craft Anything 的使用场景
useCases.description: 从获准研究的参考对象里选出关键行为，例如窄屏菜单或导入错误。交接时把实际观察、可自行决定的设计细节和验收动作分别记录。

items.title: 为内部页面做响应式替代原型
items.description: 采集桌面、平板和手机布局，另外记录导航折叠后的状态。重建时使用自己的文案和素材，交付前检查三种屏宽下的溢出、元素顺序和菜单操作。

items.title: 记录准备退役的桌面工具
items.description: 在获准使用的副本中，观察导入正常文件、空文件和失败后的界面变化。把这些现象转成替代工具的验收用例，同时标出没有复现的行为。

items.title: 单独试做一种游戏机制
items.description: 选取有权研究的移动或计分循环，用自己的美术和关卡表达。交付一个可运行的演示和可重复的玩法检查，将仍有差异的地方单独列出。

items.title: 分清主动改版和未修复的偏差
items.description: 看过对照结果后，先确认哪些变化是有意保留的，再把其余差异拆成可复测的小任务。复查受影响的屏幕或状态，让后续审阅有据可查。

prerequisites.title: 运行 Craft Anything 前的准备
prerequisites.description: 先准备获准检查的目标和独立项目目录，再核对平台发行版、编程 Agent 与所需的对照工具。只研究界面时，可以先把范围限制在可见证据。

items.title: 可用于取证的参考对象
items.description: 明确允许记录的范围，并列出需要另行授权的素材、文案或品牌元素。

items.title: 本机编程 Agent
items.description: 按上游状态说明核对后端。Claude Code 使用自己的本机安装与登录。

items.title: 可验证的任务边界
items.description: 选择有代表性的屏幕或状态，先写清比较方法。早期 Alpha 对不同目标和工具的覆盖程度有差异。

faq.question: 默认的洁净室模式能看到哪些信息？
faq.answer: 它使用截图、可见文字和布局尺寸等外部证据。需要查看有权检查的内部信息时，再切换到 Deep 模式。

faq.question: 洁净室模式会隔离编程 Agent 吗？
faq.answer: 这个模式限制 Craft Anything 提供的取证方式。操作系统和编程 Agent 仍按各自的权限执行。

faq.question: 可以直接用于正式迁移吗？
faq.answer: 上游将项目标为早期 Alpha。先用范围小的目标试跑，核对所选平台、Agent 和对照工具是否覆盖实际任务。

faq.question: 只想研究软件，可以先不重建吗？
faq.answer: 可以。上游桌面应用在 Deep 模式下提供仅检查的入口，CLI 与 MCP 也提供独立的取证工具。

faq.question: Codex 能直接作为重建的 Agent 吗？
faq.answer: 上游提供 Codex 适配器，但说明尚未在真实安装中验证。依赖这个流程前应查看对应版本的状态。

faq.question: 项目开源许可包含参考软件的素材吗？
faq.answer: Craft Anything 源码可选 MIT 或 Apache-2.0。参考软件的标志、文字、图片等仍有各自的权利边界。

en.seoTitle: OpenCut: Classic Browser Editing and the Rust Rewrite
en.seoDescription: Try timeline editing in the OpenCut Classic browser beta. Check import and export with your own clips, and distinguish the Rust rewrite from planned MCP features.
en.description: OpenCut is an open-source video editor for timeline-based work. The browser beta uses Classic while the team builds a new Rust-based editor.
en.overviewTitle: OpenCut Classic and the Rust rewrite
overview: OpenCut is a timeline editor positioned as an open-source alternative to CapCut. Its public browser beta runs the original Classic codebase. The team archives that code separately while building the next version in the main repository.

The rewrite is intended to share a Rust core across platforms and make room for plugins, an editor API and headless operation. Upstream also lists MCP among the planned capabilities. Keep an edit plan independent of those interfaces until the one you need is available and tested.

For a Floatboat workflow, prepare clip names, timecodes, a target duration and export checks. Use the browser editor to assemble and review the result by hand, and keep the source media and cut decisions available for a later revision.
en.capabilitiesTitle: What to inspect in OpenCut
en.capabilitiesIntro: Classic provides a browser editor for hands-on trials. The main repository tracks the replacement, so use the appropriate source when checking an editor behavior or following development.

capabilities.title: Timeline assembly
capabilities.description: Arrange source clips and remove unwanted intervals to evaluate how the editor handles a short sequence.

capabilities.title: Browser beta
capabilities.description: Start with the official early beta and verify that it accepts your media and can produce the output your workflow needs.

capabilities.title: Rust editor architecture
capabilities.description: Follow the main repository for work on a shared core and plugin-oriented interfaces. Check the documented release status before designing around any new API.

useCases.title: OpenCut use cases
useCases.description: Plan one short cut with a delivery target, then compare the exported file with the timeline. Check whether the intended trims, caption timing and playback survived the export.

items.title: Cut an interview highlight from a transcript
items.description: Mark a candidate opening, the main quote and a clean closing in the transcript with timecodes. Assemble the selected intervals in the browser editor and verify that transitions preserve the meaning of each answer.

items.title: Create a focused product walkthrough
items.description: Order source recordings around one user task, then remove waiting time and repeated navigation. Review the short version against a checklist for visible labels and continuity before sharing the export.

items.title: Hand off a revised cut to a reviewer
items.description: Record the source filenames, in and out points and the reason for each replacement. Give the reviewer the new video and a change list so they can compare the intended edits with the actual playback.

items.title: Evaluate a browser editor before adopting it
items.description: Use representative clips and a small test project. Record how the beta handles import, timeline edits and export on the browser and device you actually use, then judge whether it covers the delivery requirements.

prerequisites.title: What you need for a browser editing trial
prerequisites.description: Use a copy of a short source clip for the first trial. Verify import, preview and export in your own browser before moving a long or deadline-sensitive edit.

items.title: Browser and authorized media
items.description: Open the official early beta with a short set of clips you may edit and share.

items.title: Export criteria
items.description: Write down the intended duration, framing and playback checks before committing to the editor for a deliverable.

faq.question: Which OpenCut version runs on the official site?
faq.answer: The main repository points users to the Classic-based browser beta at opencut.app while the replacement is being built.

faq.question: Why is OpenCut Classic archived?
faq.answer: It is the original codebase. The team directs ongoing rewrite work to the main OpenCut repository, and the archived repository is read-only.

faq.question: Can I use OpenCut as an MCP tool today?
faq.answer: The main repository lists an MCP server in its rewrite plans. Verify a documented release and the actual tool surface before using it in an agent workflow.

faq.question: Can I depend on automated batch exports?
faq.answer: Headless operation and batch rendering are listed as rewrite goals. Verify manual export on the browser beta with a sample before planning delivery.

faq.question: Where do I check self-hosting instructions?
faq.answer: The archived Classic README documents its Bun and Docker setup. The main repository has a different development setup for the Rust rewrite.

faq.question: How is OpenCut licensed?
faq.answer: The main OpenCut repository is MIT-licensed. Source code licensing and rights to the clips or audio you use are separate.

zh.seoTitle: OpenCut：开源视频剪辑器、Classic 网页版与 Rust 重写
zh.seoDescription: 想在浏览器里试剪短片，可先用 OpenCut Classic 核对导入、时间线和导出。主仓库正在重写 Rust 版，MCP 和无界面批处理仍列在上游路线图中。
zh.description: OpenCut 是开源时间线视频编辑器。官网 Beta 运行 Classic 版本，团队正在开发基于 Rust 的新版。
zh.overviewTitle: OpenCut 的 Classic 版本与 Rust 重写
overview: OpenCut 是面向时间线剪辑的开源编辑器，可作为 CapCut 的替代方案之一。官网提供基于原始代码的浏览器 Beta。团队已单独归档 Classic 仓库，在主仓库开发下一版。
新版计划在不同平台之间复用 Rust 内核，并提供插件、编辑器 API 与无界面运行能力。MCP 也在上游路线图中。工作流要依赖某个接口时，应先核对它所在的实际发行版。
如果用 Floatboat 准备剪辑工作，可以先整理源文件、时间码、目标时长与验收项，再用浏览器编辑器手动组装和检查。保留素材与剪辑决定，下一轮修改时就能回溯每处调整。
zh.capabilitiesTitle: 评估 OpenCut 时可以看什么
zh.capabilitiesIntro: Classic 网页版可用于验证素材导入和时间线编辑；新版接口的设计与开发在主仓库。需要评估自动化时，先确认相关能力在哪一版实际可用。

capabilities.title: 时间线剪辑
capabilities.description: 将素材排进时间线，移除多余片段，观察短片的预览和衔接是否符合交付要求。

capabilities.title: 浏览器 Beta
capabilities.description: 从官网早期 Beta 开始，验证实际素材能否导入，以及导出结果能否用于当前任务。

capabilities.title: Rust 编辑器架构
capabilities.description: 在主仓库跟进共享内核和插件接口。准备依赖某个新接口前，先查看对应版本的实际发布状态。

useCases.title: OpenCut 的使用场景
useCases.description: 用一段目标明确的短素材试剪。清单记录每个片段为什么保留、从哪里剪起，导出后再按时间码检查衔接、字幕和画面是否符合交付要求。

items.title: 从访谈逐字稿剪出精彩片段
items.description: 在逐字稿上为开场、核心引语和结尾标记时间码。把选中的区间排进时间线，再检查衔接有没有改变受访者的原意。

items.title: 整理一段产品操作演示
items.description: 围绕一个任务排序录屏，删掉等待和重复导航。分享前核对关键界面文字是否可见，前后操作是否连贯。

items.title: 把修订版交给同事审阅
items.description: 记录每次替换涉及的源文件、起止点和调整理由。将新版视频与改动清单一并交付，让同事可以按实际播放结果核对。

items.title: 评估网页剪辑能否满足交付
items.description: 挑有代表性的素材建一个小项目，在日常使用的浏览器和设备上实际检查导入、时间线编辑及导出，再根据交付要求判断。

prerequisites.title: 试剪前准备什么
prerequisites.description: 首轮用一份短素材副本，在自己的浏览器里跑通导入、预览和导出。核对文件格式、目标分辨率和播放结果后，再决定是否用于长片或正式任务。

items.title: 浏览器与授权素材
items.description: 打开官方 Beta，准备一组有权编辑和分享的短素材。

items.title: 导出验收项
items.description: 先记下目标时长、画面构图和播放检查点，试剪后逐项确认。

faq.question: OpenCut 官网现在运行哪一版？
faq.answer: 主仓库指向 opencut.app 的 Classic 浏览器 Beta，新版代码仍在主仓库开发。

faq.question: 为什么 OpenCut Classic 仓库已归档？
faq.answer: 它保存的是原始代码。团队将重写工作转到主仓库，Classic 的源代码仍可只读查阅。

faq.question: 现在可以用 MCP 调用 OpenCut 吗？
faq.answer: 上游把 MCP 服务列入新版计划。接入前需核对实际发行版和可调用工具。

faq.question: 可以依赖自动批量导出吗？
faq.answer: 无界面运行和批量渲染是新版目标。交付前可以先用代表性素材验证浏览器版的手动导出。

faq.question: 在哪里查看自部署说明？
faq.answer: Classic 归档仓库的 README 记录了 Bun 与 Docker 的配置，新版主仓库另有开发环境说明。

faq.question: OpenCut 用的是什么许可证？
faq.answer: OpenCut 主仓库采用 MIT。用于剪辑的视频、音频及其他素材仍按各自授权处理。

en.seoTitle: OpenMontage: AI Agent Video Pipelines and Render Review
en.seoDescription: OpenMontage gives coding agents staged video pipelines for footage, narration and captions. Compare source options and render checks before delivering a cut.
en.description: OpenMontage gives a coding agent production plans and tools for moving a video from brief to rendered cut, with review points for footage, audio and captions.
en.overviewTitle: How OpenMontage stages a video production
overview: A product demo needs a script, screen recordings, captions and a final cut. OpenMontage breaks that work into stages with YAML pipeline definitions and separate instructions for the coding agent. The agent reads the plan, calls the relevant tools and records decisions and progress so later steps can use the same production context.

Different projects take different paths. An explainer may use generated stills and a Remotion composition, while a documentary montage can retrieve real motion clips from open archives and use them to assemble a timeline. The available providers, credentials and asset rights determine which path you can take.

For a Floatboat workflow, use the project as a reference for sequencing a brief, asset approval and cut review. Keep the intended delivery format visible from the beginning, then inspect sampled frames, captions and audio against that brief after rendering.
en.capabilitiesTitle: The production decisions OpenMontage makes visible
en.capabilitiesIntro: The pipeline leaves a record of which tools and assets were selected and when a result was checked. Use it to review choices that affect the finished cut, such as the footage source and composition engine.

capabilities.title: Stage definitions
capabilities.description: A YAML manifest describes production steps, the tools involved and the conditions to check before moving on.

capabilities.title: Asset and provider selection
capabilities.description: The agent can use source footage, local tools or configured cloud services, with selection rules that account for fit and cost.

capabilities.title: Checks on the rendered cut
capabilities.description: The project uses tools such as ffprobe, sampled frames and audio analysis to flag technical issues for review.

useCases.title: OpenMontage use cases
useCases.description: Pick the output first, from a real-footage montage to a captioned demo. Then choose the stages and inspection points that protect what the audience needs to see or hear.

items.title: Edit a short product demonstration
items.description: Start with a screen recording and a list of actions the viewer must see. Use the pipeline to draft the cut and captions, then verify that captions stay clear of controls and the edit preserves each essential step.

items.title: Build a montage from real motion clips
items.description: Specify real footage and a theme before sourcing. Track the origin and usage conditions of each candidate, then review whether the cut combines actual moving clips at the intended pace.

items.title: Create an animated explainer with a voice track
items.description: Approve the script and scene plan before producing visual assets. Render a short sample and listen for awkward pronunciations, then verify that scene changes still line up with narration after any revisions.

items.title: Prepare a localized version of a finished video
items.description: Retain the source transcript and use it to review the translated script before producing a new voice track. Check subtitle wrapping and time alignment in the localized render, especially around rapid speech or labels.

prerequisites.title: What to prepare for the source workflow
prerequisites.description: The upstream quick start runs inside a coding-agent workspace. Prepare the runtime and approved inputs before selecting a pipeline, and enable provider credentials only for services your production needs.

items.title: Project runtime
items.description: The source quick start lists Python 3.10+, Node.js 18+, FFmpeg and an AI coding assistant.

items.title: Material and delivery brief
items.description: Gather approved footage or source links, and specify duration, aspect ratio, audience and the expected output format.

items.title: Provider access
items.description: Some paths use local tools and open sources. Configured cloud models and some stock services require separate credentials and may incur charges.

faq.question: What runs the pipeline stages?
faq.answer: The coding assistant reads the stage definitions and calls the project tools. Its workspace and execution permissions govern what it can do.

faq.question: Can OpenMontage use real motion clips?
faq.answer: Yes. Its documentary montage path can search a collection of open archival footage and cut selected clips into a timeline. Review the rights of each asset you use.

faq.question: Do I need paid video generation to make a montage?
faq.answer: The repository describes a path using real footage from open sources and local processing. Other providers have their own credentials, terms and costs.

faq.question: How does the project review a final render?
faq.answer: It documents technical checks such as probing the media file, sampling frames and analyzing audio. Review editorial intent, rights and accuracy before releasing the cut.

faq.question: Is OpenMontage Studio the same thing as the repository?
faq.answer: The public repository documents the source workflow for a coding assistant. The website describes Studio as a Windows desktop app in private alpha.

faq.question: What does the AGPL cover?
faq.answer: The repository lists GNU AGPL v3 for the source. Footage, fonts and third-party services may have separate terms that need checking for your production.

zh.seoTitle: OpenMontage：Agent 视频制作、素材编排与成片验收
zh.seoDescription: 从选素材、写脚本到检查字幕和成片，OpenMontage 用分阶段流程组织编程 Agent 的视频制作。按片型选择合成工具和模型服务，并核对素材许可与渲染结果。
zh.description: OpenMontage 为编程 Agent 提供视频制作流程和工具，从拆解脚本与准备素材，到合成、渲染和检查成片。
zh.overviewTitle: OpenMontage 如何把制作计划推进到成片
overview: 一条产品演示通常需要脚本、屏幕录制、字幕和成片。OpenMontage 用 YAML 定义制作阶段，再用分阶段的说明指导编程 Agent 调用工具。项目会记录进度和选择，后续步骤可以沿用同一份制作背景。
不同内容走不同的路线。讲解片可以生成静态画面再交给 Remotion 合成；纪录片式蒙太奇可以从开放档案检索真实运动镜头，再安排时间线。选哪条路取决于素材许可、可用工具和外部服务凭据。
如果要在 Floatboat 设计视频工作流，可以参考它对任务书、素材确认和成片检查的拆分。先明确交付比例、时长和内容重点，渲染后再用关键帧、字幕和音轨逐项对照，保留需要返工的记录。
zh.capabilitiesTitle: OpenMontage 的制作流程和检查依据
zh.capabilitiesIntro: 制作记录保留选用的素材、合成工具与各阶段检查结果。回看成片时，可以追溯字幕错位、节奏不顺或画面问题出在哪个环节。

capabilities.title: 分阶段制作计划
capabilities.description: YAML 清单列出各阶段、要调用的工具和进入下一阶段前需要检查的条件。

capabilities.title: 素材和服务选择
capabilities.description: 按项目需求使用已有素材、本地工具或配置的云服务，并参考任务匹配度与成本。

capabilities.title: 渲染结果检查
capabilities.description: 用 ffprobe、画面采样与音频分析等工具发现技术问题，再回看对应片段。

useCases.title: OpenMontage 的使用场景
useCases.description: 先确定片型和交付方式。真实镜头拼接要核对来源和衔接，产品演示关注操作是否可见，多语字幕还需要逐段检查文案与时间码。

items.title: 剪辑一条短产品演示
items.description: 把录屏和必须呈现的动作写进任务书，请 Agent 规划剪辑与字幕。交付前检查字幕是否遮住控件，关键操作是否被跳剪省略。

items.title: 用真实镜头组一条蒙太奇
items.description: 在素材检索前先写明只用真实运动镜头和主题。保留每个片段的来源与使用条件，成片阶段检查镜头是否符合预期节奏，避免误用静态画面来填时长。

items.title: 制作有旁白的动画讲解
items.description: 先审脚本和分镜，再准备画面素材。用短样片听清关键名词的读法，调整旁白后复查场景切换仍然跟得上讲述节奏。

items.title: 为成片制作多语版本

faq.question: 谁来执行 OpenMontage 的各个制作阶段？

faq.question: OpenMontage Studio 和开源仓库是同一个入口吗？

faq.question: AGPL 许可覆盖哪些内容？

en.seoTitle: OpenDesign: AI Design Workspace for Prototypes and Decks
en.seoDescription: Turn a brief into a prototype, deck or motion asset in OpenDesign. Review how DESIGN.md guides the agent and which editable files the next reviewer receives.
en.description: OpenDesign is an open-source workspace for turning a design brief into interactive prototypes, presentation decks and motion graphics with an AI agent.
en.overviewTitle: From a design brief to an editable artifact
overview: OpenDesign combines a design brief with an output template and an active design system. The design system centers on DESIGN.md, a portable description of visual rules, and can also include tokens, components and assets. In the prototype workflow, a coding agent applies those rules to produce HTML you can preview and refine.

With a filesystem-backed coding agent, the agent writes directly to the project files. A plain API run without file tools returns a complete artifact block instead. OpenDesign also provides an MCP server through which a configured external client can read files such as CSS tokens, JSX components and entry HTML from local projects.

The desktop app and self-hosted option let you work with local project files. Requests that use a cloud model or OpenDesign Cloud go to the corresponding service. Choose the execution path before you add a confidential design brief, source code or licensed assets.
en.capabilitiesTitle: What OpenDesign gives a design team
en.capabilitiesIntro: The workspace separates brand rules, output templates and agent behavior. You can change the format of a deliverable while keeping the design system available for the next iteration.

capabilities.title: Reusable design systems
capabilities.description: Record color, typography, layout and component rules in DESIGN.md. Project packages can also carry tokens and component examples.

capabilities.title: Multiple design surfaces
capabilities.description: Start from a template for an interactive prototype, a deck or a motion project. Export options vary by the artifact, such as PPTX for decks and MP4 for HyperFrames motion.

capabilities.title: Editable handoff
capabilities.description: Use local project files as the handoff for engineering. The upstream MCP server can expose named files to a configured client when the workflow crosses repository boundaries.

useCases.title: OpenDesign use cases
useCases.description: Choose the format the reviewer can assess. A product flow may need a clickable prototype, while a launch deck needs a clear sequence and a motion concept needs timing you can inspect.

items.title: Prototype onboarding before assigning implementation
items.description: Supply the supported paths, error states and sample copy for a three-screen flow. Preview the HTML artifact with product and engineering, agree on the missing states, and pass the files plus acceptance criteria to the implementation owner.

items.title: Apply a shared visual system to campaign drafts
items.description: Put type scale, spacing and approved colors in DESIGN.md, then use those rules across a landing-page concept and a presentation. Compare how the hierarchy works in each format and retain the confirmed design system for the next brief.

items.title: Review a deck as a story and as a file
items.description: Use the deck workflow to structure a pitch around one decision and the evidence behind it. Review slide order and notes in the workspace, then open the exported file in the target presentation app to check type and layout.

items.title: Hand off a short motion study
items.description: Make a small HyperFrames motion draft for a feature reveal. Inspect the opening, transition and final frame, then share the timing decisions alongside the MP4 so the next revision can change one beat without rebuilding the concept.

prerequisites.title: Choose how to run OpenDesign
prerequisites.description: The desktop and source routes have different requirements. Confirm your platform and model access first, then choose a small artifact to check the complete handoff.

items.title: Desktop builds
items.description: Upstream lists installers for macOS and Windows x64. It currently directs Linux users to run from source.

items.title: Source setup
items.description: Follow the upstream quickstart for Node and pnpm versions and its development launcher.

items.title: Agent and data access
items.description: Choose a supported installed coding agent or configure a model endpoint and credentials. Check provider handling of prompts and files before adding sensitive material.

faq.question: What is DESIGN.md in OpenDesign?
faq.answer: It records visual rules for the active design system. Packages can also include design tokens, components, assets and source information.

faq.question: Can I start from an existing design system?
faq.answer: Yes. A project can use a design-system package, including one centered on your own DESIGN.md. Check the license and provenance of any borrowed assets.

faq.question: Does local-first mean no requests leave my device?
faq.answer: No. Cloud models and OpenDesign Cloud receive their respective requests. Confirm which runtime and service the project uses before sharing sensitive inputs.

faq.question: How do I hand off a prototype to a developer?
faq.answer: Review the interactive result, then pass the HTML and relevant project files with behavior and accessibility requirements. Confirm which pieces need production implementation.

faq.question: Can another agent read my OpenDesign files?
faq.answer: The upstream stdio MCP server can expose selected local project files to a configured MCP client. Review the client and the project material you plan to expose.

faq.question: Is a Linux installer available?
faq.answer: The upstream quickstart currently directs Linux users to run from source. Check the releases page for changes before planning a rollout.

zh.seoTitle: OpenDesign：AI 原型、演示文稿与动效设计工作区
zh.seoDescription: 用 DESIGN.md 为 Agent 明确配色、排版和组件规则，再在 OpenDesign 里制作原型、演示文稿或动效。交接前核对可编辑文件，以及所选模型会在本机还是云端处理输入。
zh.description: OpenDesign 是一款开源设计工作区。你可以和 AI Agent 一起把设计需求做成可交互原型、演示文稿或动效，再预览并修改交付物。
zh.overviewTitle: 从设计需求到可编辑的交付物
overview: OpenDesign 将设计需求、输出模板和当前设计系统组合起来。设计系统以 DESIGN.md 为核心，记录可复用的视觉规则，也可以包含设计变量、组件和素材。做界面原型时，编程 Agent 根据这些约束生成 HTML，供团队预览和修改。
能访问文件系统的本机 Agent 可以直接写入项目文件。没有文件工具的纯 API 运行则返回一个完整的产物块。OpenDesign 也提供 MCP 服务，配置好客户端后，其他 Agent 可以按名称读取本地项目中的 CSS 变量、JSX 组件或入口 HTML。
桌面应用和自行部署方式可以使用本地项目文件。调用云模型或 OpenDesign Cloud 时，相关请求会发送到对应服务。处理未公开的方案、代码或受许可限制的素材前，先确认项目采用的执行方式。
zh.capabilitiesTitle: OpenDesign 如何组织设计工作
zh.capabilitiesIntro: 把品牌规则、输出模板和 Agent 工作方式分开维护。同一套配色与排版规则可沿用到不同交付物，预览和验收仍按原型、演示文稿或动效各自的要求执行。

capabilities.title: 设计规则可复用
capabilities.description: 用 DESIGN.md 记录配色、字体、布局和组件规则。设计系统还可以附带设计变量和组件示例。

capabilities.title: 按交付形式选择模板
capabilities.description: 交互原型、演示文稿和动效项目使用各自的模板。根据产物选择导出形式，例如演示文稿的 PPTX 或 HyperFrames 动效的 MP4。

capabilities.title: 把可编辑文件交给开发
capabilities.description: 将本地项目文件纳入交接清单。需要跨仓库工作时，可以配置 MCP 客户端读取特定文件。

useCases.title: OpenDesign 的使用场景
useCases.description: 先看审阅人需要判断什么。交互原型让开发检查状态与路径，发布演示文稿用于确认叙事顺序，动效则要核对镜头衔接与节奏。

items.title: 在开发排期前跑通新手引导
items.description: 把三屏引导的入口、分支、失败状态和示例文案交给 Agent。产品和工程一起预览可点击的 HTML，确认遗漏状态后再交接文件和验收标准。

items.title: 让活动页面和方案演示沿用同套视觉规则
items.description: 把字号层级、间距和已批准的颜色写进 DESIGN.md，再用于落地页草稿和演示文稿。分别检查两种形式里的阅读顺序，把验证过的规则留给下一批物料。

items.title: 同时审阅演示内容和导出文件
items.description: 先围绕需要确认的决策排好页面和证据，逐页检查讲稿。导出后在接收方使用的演示软件里打开，核对字体、断行和内容是否被裁切。

items.title: 交接一段短动效的节奏
items.description: 做一段用于功能亮相的 HyperFrames 草稿，检查开场、转场和最后一帧。把节奏说明和 MP4 一起交给同事，后续可以只调整一个镜头的时长。

prerequisites.title: 运行 OpenDesign 前的准备
prerequisites.description: 桌面版和源码运行需要不同的环境。确认平台、模型访问路径和交付格式后，用一个小任务走完预览与导出，检查接手人能否继续编辑。

items.title: 桌面平台
items.description: 上游列出了 macOS 和 Windows x64 安装包。目前 Linux 用户需要从源码运行。

items.title: 源码环境
items.description: 按官方快速入门核对 Node、pnpm 版本和启动方式。

items.title: Agent 与数据权限
items.description: 选用已安装的受支持编程 Agent，或配置模型端点及凭据。加入敏感内容前，检查提供商如何处理请求和文件。

faq.question: DESIGN.md 在 OpenDesign 里有什么用？
faq.answer: 它描述当前设计系统的视觉规则。设计系统还可以包含设计变量、组件、素材和来源信息。

faq.question: 可以使用团队现有的设计系统吗？
faq.answer: 可以准备以自有 DESIGN.md 为核心的设计系统包。引用外部素材时，先核对各项内容的许可和来源。

faq.question: 本地优先意味着数据始终留在本机吗？
faq.answer: 如果项目调用云模型或 OpenDesign Cloud，相应请求会发送到对应服务。处理敏感输入前要先核对项目选用的运行方式。

faq.question: 如何把界面原型交给开发？
faq.answer: 确认预览中的交互，再交接 HTML、相关项目文件以及行为与无障碍要求。明确哪些部分还要按生产标准实现。

faq.question: 其他 Agent 可以读取 OpenDesign 文件吗？
faq.answer: 上游提供 stdio MCP 服务，配置好的客户端可按名称读取本地项目文件。连接前先检查可暴露的内容和客户端权限。

faq.question: 有现成的 Linux 安装包吗？
faq.answer: 上游快速入门目前指引 Linux 用户从源码运行。需要部署前，可以在 GitHub Releases 核对最新支持情况。

en.seoTitle: Claude-Mem: Persistent Agent Memory and Layered MCP Search
en.seoDescription: Claude-Mem records coding observations across sessions. Retrieve a compact index before loading selected details, and check what inference or sync may send off-device.
en.description: Claude-Mem summarizes observations from coding agents and retrieves relevant history when work resumes in another session.
en.overviewTitle: How Claude-Mem recovers context across sessions
overview: When a coding session ends, its tool outputs and decisions can be hard to recover. Claude-Mem captures observations through host-specific integrations, creates summaries and stores session records that can be searched later. The local worker and viewer make it possible to inspect which records were saved.

Search starts with a compact list of observation IDs. The timeline tool shows nearby activity, and selected records can then be opened in full. Startup context has its own settings. For Claude Code and Codex, it defaults to observations from the current host, with a setting to include other sources.

A Floatboat handoff can borrow this pattern by storing a small decision log and retrieving only what the next task needs. Compare recalled claims against current code and tests, and decide which material can be recorded before enabling hooks, observation providers or optional sync.
en.capabilitiesTitle: What Claude-Mem keeps and retrieves
en.capabilitiesIntro: The capture, storage and search paths do different jobs. Test the worker with a disposable repository before choosing how much past context to return in a new session.

capabilities.title: Session observation hooks
capabilities.description: Capture tool activity through the integration for your coding host. Check what that host can observe before choosing where to enable capture.

capabilities.title: Local worker and viewer
capabilities.description: Inspect saved observations and summaries in the web viewer. The local worker keeps sessions, observations and summaries in SQLite.

capabilities.title: Layered MCP retrieval
capabilities.description: Search for observation IDs, look at surrounding events, and fetch complete records only for selected results.

useCases.title: Claude-Mem use cases
useCases.description: Search the observation index for a past decision, then retrieve only the details you need. Check the old record against the current branch and tests before reusing the decision.

items.title: Resume a bug investigation after a session reset
items.description: Search for a symptom, failing test or function name, then read the nearby observations. Match the earlier reproduction steps against the current branch and rerun the failed check before changing the implementation.

items.title: Recover the reason behind an old design decision
items.description: Look for the decision and the events leading up to it. Compare the retrieved explanation with the commit and any later changes so a past workaround does not become an accidental requirement.

items.title: Review context before moving to a different coding agent
items.description: Check whether the receiving host should include observations from other sources. Try with a synthetic handoff first and inspect the resulting startup context to make sure it contains the intended project and scope.

items.title: Audit what should be remembered from a test session
items.description: Run a harmless task with approved sample text. Open the local viewer and compare what was stored with what the workflow was allowed to retain, including a test of the documented private-content marker.

prerequisites.title: What to check before enabling memory
prerequisites.description: Choose a supported coding agent and a disposable repository for the first run. Check which events it captures, what a fresh session receives, and whether inference or sync leaves the device.

items.title: A supported coding host
items.description: Follow the install guide for your host. The Claude Code setup documents Node.js 20 or later and a version of Claude Code with plugin support.

items.title: An explicit data scope
items.description: Choose what the plugin may record and review the provider and sync settings before running it with customer data or internal repositories.

items.title: A way to inspect retained context
items.description: Open the local viewer and try a search, a timeline lookup and retrieval by observation ID with your sample session.

faq.question: Is Claude-Mem made by Anthropic?
faq.answer: The upstream README credits Alex Newman, whose GitHub handle is thedotmack. Claude Code is a host the project integrates with.

faq.question: Does it store every full session in the context window?
faq.answer: The project captures observations and summaries. Startup context can be limited, and the MCP flow retrieves the full record only for selected results.

faq.question: Does cross-host context injection happen by default?
faq.answer: The README documents that Claude Code and Codex startup use the current host’s observations by default. Including all sources requires a setting change.

faq.question: Is local storage the same as local inference?
faq.answer: No. The worker can keep records locally, while summarization uses the chosen observer provider. Review provider settings and optional sync separately.

faq.question: What should I check before capturing confidential work?
faq.answer: Inspect what the selected integration captures, test the private-content exclusion in a disposable project, and review the observer and sync destinations.

faq.question: What does the Apache-2.0 license cover?
faq.answer: The upstream license documentation covers the public core, including the memory engine, server, CLI, SDKs and adapters. Hosted and reserved commercial services are described separately.

en.articleDescription: Learn which decisions and project records help a new session resume work.

zh.seoTitle: Claude-Mem：编程 Agent 跨会话记忆与分层 MCP 检索
zh.seoDescription: 新会话需要找回上次的实现决定时，Claude-Mem 可先搜索观察记录，再取回相关细节。部署前分别核对宿主采集范围、摘要模型和可选同步。
zh.description: Claude-Mem 将编程 Agent 的操作整理成可检索的观察记录和摘要，方便在新的会话中接着之前的工作。
zh.overviewTitle: Claude-Mem 怎样找回之前的工作上下文
overview: 编程会话结束后，工具输出和决策理由容易散落在历史记录里。Claude-Mem 通过不同宿主的集成采集观察、生成摘要，并保留可检索的会话记录。可以在本地工作进程的界面里查看存下了什么。
检索先返回带编号的简短索引，再沿时间线查看附近事件，最后只读取选中记录的全文。启动时注入的上下文有独立设置。Claude Code 和 Codex 默认使用当前宿主的观察记录，可以设置为包含其他来源。
如果用 Floatboat 交接任务，可以借鉴这种做法：保存少量有价值的决定，按下一个任务检索。拿到历史解释后用当前代码和测试复核，并在开启采集、摘要服务或同步前先划定数据范围。
zh.capabilitiesTitle: Claude-Mem 记录和检索哪些信息
zh.capabilitiesIntro: 采集决定哪些活动留下记录，存储决定记录在哪里，检索决定新会话读多少。先用临时仓库核对本地工作进程的记录和返回内容。

capabilities.title: 会话观察与事件钩子
capabilities.description: 通过对应编程宿主的集成记录工具活动。不同宿主能捕获的信息有差异，启用前可以先核对。

capabilities.title: 本地工作进程与查看界面
capabilities.description: 用网页界面检查已经保存的观察和摘要。本地工作进程在 SQLite 中存放会话、观察与摘要。

capabilities.title: 分层 MCP 检索
capabilities.description: 先找观察编号，再查看相关时间线，只为选中的结果读取完整记录。

useCases.title: Claude-Mem 的使用场景
useCases.description: 把检索到的观察当作历史线索。先找回能解释旧决定的那条记录，再对照当前分支、依赖和测试，确认当时的条件是否依然成立。

items.title: 会话重置后继续排查错误
items.description: 用症状、失败的测试名或函数名找到先前的观察记录。对照当前分支复跑当时的步骤，确认错误仍能复现再动代码。

items.title: 找回旧架构决定的理由
items.description: 查找当时的决定和它前后的操作，再与对应提交和后续修改对照。这样能判断临时补丁是否还需要保留。

items.title: 换编程 Agent 前确认交接范围
items.description: 先决定接收方是否要读取其他宿主的观察记录。用一份模拟交接测试启动上下文，核对项目和来源是否在预期范围内。

items.title: 抽查一次会话保留了哪些内容
items.description: 用获准的样本文字做一个小任务，在本地查看界面对照已保存的记录，顺便验证项目文档提供的私密内容标记是否生效。

prerequisites.title: 开启会话记忆前需要检查什么
prerequisites.description: 不同宿主能采集的事件并不完全相同。用测试项目分别检查启动时注入的历史、摘要模型的处理路径，以及可选同步会发送哪些数据。

items.title: 支持的编程宿主
items.description: 按对应安装说明准备。Claude Code 路径要求 Node.js 20 或更新版本，以及支持插件的 Claude Code。

items.title: 清晰的数据范围
items.description: 决定哪些活动允许记录，并在接触客户资料或内部仓库前核对摘要服务和同步设置。

items.title: 复查记忆的方式
items.description: 在本地界面选一段测试会话，验证索引搜索、时间线与按观察编号读取详情。

faq.question: Claude-Mem 是 Anthropic 发布的吗？
faq.answer: 上游 README 将作者标为 Alex Newman，GitHub 账号是 thedotmack。Claude Code 是它支持的编程宿主之一。

faq.question: 新会话会加载之前的整段对话吗？
faq.answer: 项目保留观察和摘要。启动上下文可以限制，MCP 检索也可以只打开挑选出来的完整记录。

faq.question: 默认会跨宿主注入历史吗？
faq.answer: 上游文档说明 Claude Code 和 Codex 启动时默认只用当前宿主的观察记录。纳入其他来源需要调整设置。

faq.question: 本地存储就意味着摘要也在本地生成吗？
faq.answer: 工作进程可以在本地保存记录。摘要使用所选的观察服务，可选同步也有独立设置，三者应分别核对。

faq.question: 处理敏感项目之前应该验证什么？
faq.answer: 在临时项目核对实际采集的内容和私密标记的效果，再确认摘要请求和可选同步各自会发往哪里。

faq.question: Apache-2.0 覆盖哪些部分？
faq.answer: 上游许可说明涵盖公开核心，包括记忆引擎、服务端、CLI、SDK 与适配器。托管和保留的商业服务另行说明。

en.seoTitle: Caveman Engine: Recoverable Compression for Agent Tool Output
en.seoDescription: Caveman Engine compresses logs, diffs and JSON locally. Check how lossy results preserve exact originals for recovery, and compare token estimates with actual usage.
en.description: Caveman Engine compresses the data a model reads, such as logs, JSON and diffs, and preserves original bytes for recovery when a shorter result discards detail.
en.overviewTitle: What Caveman Engine compresses and preserves
overview: An agent often reads the same long logs, diffs or structured output while investigating a problem. Caveman Engine is a local Go library and runtime that detects the shape of incoming data and selects a matching transform. It addresses the context the model reads. The separate Caveman Skill changes how the agent writes its response.

The compact representation can omit detail. Before emitting a lossy result, the engine requires a recoverable copy of the original. It returns the source bytes on unsuitable inputs, invalid or larger results, or recovery storage failure. Local token estimates can help compare candidates, while provider usage and invoices remain separate evidence.

For a Floatboat workflow, use the engine as a reference for preserving originals behind short evidence excerpts. Compare an uncompressed baseline with a compressed run on the same task, recover a specific omitted detail on demand and check that both runs reach the same substantive decision.
en.capabilitiesTitle: How the engine keeps originals available
en.capabilitiesIntro: Inspect the input, the compact result and the recovery path together. A shorter result has value when the agent can still retrieve what it needs to make or verify a decision.

capabilities.title: Shape-aware compression
capabilities.description: Choose different transforms for inputs such as JSON, code, logs, test reports and diffs. Some transforms require explicit selection.

capabilities.title: Exact source recovery
capabilities.description: Keep original bytes before emitting a lossy replacement, and retrieve them through a recovery handle when the compact result is insufficient.

capabilities.title: Pass-through and local measurement
capabilities.description: Keep original bytes when no safe, smaller result is available. Compare local inferred token counts separately from provider-reported usage.

useCases.title: Caveman Engine use cases
useCases.description: Start with a repeated tool result that already has an expected outcome. Compare what the compressed view retains, how omitted detail is recovered and whether the agent’s decision still holds.

items.title: Triage recurring test failures
items.description: Use a representative test report with both passing cases and multiple failures. Check that failure details stay available in the compact view, then recover the full report when validating a borderline diagnosis.

items.title: Review a large diff without losing the patch
items.description: Test whether a compact diff helps the agent locate the right files and changes. Keep the original patch retrievable and use it for any line-level review before approving a merge.

items.title: Keep long log evidence traceable
items.description: Run a sanitized incident log through the same query with and without compression. Verify that the abbreviated result preserves the error sequence needed for triage and that omitted lines can be recovered before escalation.

items.title: Measure an agent’s context overhead
items.description: Compare local token estimates for a fixed set of tool outputs and log how many decisions require recovery. If you also have provider usage, reconcile it separately and retain the task-quality and latency results.

prerequisites.title: What to prepare for a compression trial
prerequisites.description: Start with representative inputs and an approved place to retain originals. Confirm the runtime and agent profile before sending live tool results through a compressed path.

items.title: A supported build and agent path
items.description: Choose the documented native CLI, Go library or another supported runtime. Agent-specific interception and recovery depend on the host protocol.

items.title: A controlled recovery store
items.description: Set a retention policy, capacity and access scope appropriate to the original inputs. Lossy output depends on a successful recovery path.

items.title: A comparison fixture
items.description: Keep a raw baseline, a known task outcome and exact details the compact representation must let you recover.

faq.question: Does the Caveman Skill enable the engine?
faq.answer: The Skill changes response style. The engine is separate runtime software for compressing what the model reads.

faq.question: Can the engine recover the exact original?
faq.answer: Lossy output requires a recoverable original. Use the returned handle through the supported retrieval path to verify the original bytes.

faq.question: What happens when no transform is suitable?
faq.answer: The documented flow passes through the source on parse failure, a larger result or an unavailable required recovery store.

faq.question: Do inferred tokens measure my provider bill?
faq.answer: Local counters estimate tokens for comparison. Provider-reported usage and actual bills depend on the model, tokenizer and service.

faq.question: Do all builds compress the same programming languages?
faq.answer: Support depends on the build. Upstream documents broader source-language parsing in the cgo release binaries than in the pure-Go builds.

faq.question: Which versions use Apache-2.0?
faq.answer: Upstream applies Apache-2.0 from 3.0.0 onward. Earlier releases retain their shipped terms, and the separately hosted Caveman Cloud has its own commercial terms.

zh.seoTitle: Caveman Engine：压缩 Agent 工具输出并保留可恢复原文
zh.seoDescription: Caveman Engine 在本地压缩日志、代码差异和 JSON。有损结果通过恢复标识保留取回原文的路径；评估时可对照本地 Token 估算、实际用量与版本许可。
zh.description: Caveman Engine 压缩模型读取的日志、JSON 和差异等数据，并在有损压缩时保存原始字节供后续恢复。
zh.overviewTitle: Caveman Engine 压缩什么，保留什么
overview: Agent 调查问题时可能反复读取很长的日志、代码差异或结构化工具输出。Caveman Engine 是本地 Go 库和运行时，会先识别输入结构，再选择对应的压缩方式。它处理模型读取的上下文；单独的 Caveman Skill 调整的是 Agent 回答的表达方式。
压缩后的视图可能省略细节。引擎在输出有损结果前需要先保存可恢复的原文。输入不适合压缩、转换失败、结果更大或恢复存储不可用时，都会保留原始输入。本地 Token 统计可以用于对比，实际账单仍要查服务商的用量。
在 Floatboat 设计工作流时，可以借鉴这种保留原文的做法：用同一个任务跑一轮原始数据和一轮压缩数据，要求 Agent 按需恢复一条被省略的细节，再检查两轮是否得出了相同的实质判断。
zh.capabilitiesTitle: Caveman Engine 如何保留可追溯的原始数据
zh.capabilitiesIntro: 同时保留原始输入、压缩结果与取回方式。短版适合快速判断，遇到关键字段或失败堆栈被省略时，再用恢复标识核对原文。

capabilities.title: 按数据结构选择压缩方式
capabilities.description: 日志、JSON、代码、测试报告和差异可以采用不同转换。有些转换需要明确指定。

capabilities.title: 有损压缩前保存原文
capabilities.description: 引擎在输出有损结果前保存原始数据。需要核对被省略的信息时，用对应的恢复标识取回原文。

capabilities.title: 回退与本地计量
capabilities.description: 找不到更小且满足要求的结果时保留原始输入。本地估算的 Token 数量与服务商用量分开核算。

useCases.title: Caveman Engine 的使用场景
useCases.description: 找一类反复读取且已有预期结论的工具结果。逐项核对压缩保留了什么、遗漏的信息能否取回，以及模型看过简版后是否仍能作出同样的判断。

items.title: 排查测试失败
items.description: 选一份同时包含通过用例和多种失败的测试报告，确认短视图能定位失败。遇到证据不足的诊断，再恢复完整报告复核。

items.title: 审阅较大差异时保留补丁
items.description: 先用压缩差异定位需要查看的文件和修改，再从原始补丁检查具体行。确认逐行审阅可复现后再批准合并。

items.title: 检查事件日志是否还能追溯
items.description: 用脱敏日志对比原始版和压缩版的同一道问题。确认错误顺序能支持初步定位，升级事件前还能恢复被略过的日志行。

items.title: 评估重复工具输出的上下文开销
items.description: 固定一组工具输出，比较本地 Token 估算并记录哪些判断触发了恢复。如果有供应商用量，单独对账，同时记录质量和延迟的变化。

prerequisites.title: 试用上下文压缩前的准备
prerequisites.description: 先确定代表性的日志、代码差异和结构化结果，以及获准保存原文的位置。用样本核对运行时与 Agent 接入方式，再决定何时启用压缩。

items.title: 运行环境和宿主
items.description: 从上游文档选择本机 CLI、Go 库或其他支持的运行方式。拦截和恢复能力随宿主协议而异。

items.title: 受控的原文存储
items.description: 根据数据敏感度设置访问范围、保留期限和容量。有损压缩需要先确认原文可以恢复。

items.title: 可重复的验证样本
items.description: 保留未压缩基线、已知任务结果，以及短视图应当允许恢复的具体细节。

faq.question: 安装 Caveman Skill 会启用引擎吗？
faq.answer: Caveman Skill 调整回答风格。Engine 是独立运行时，负责压缩模型读取的数据。

faq.question: 可以恢复逐字节一致的原文吗？
faq.answer: 引擎要求有损结果对应可恢复的原始字节。可以用返回的句柄验证所选环境是否能取回原文。

faq.question: 找不到适合的压缩方式会怎样？
faq.answer: 解析失败、转换结果更大或所需的恢复存储不可用时，上游流程会直接返回原始内容。

faq.question: 本地估算的 Token 能用来对账吗？
faq.answer: 它适合比较样本。实际用量仍取决于服务商、模型与分词方式，应查看供应商记录。

faq.question: 所有构建都支持相同的代码语言吗？
faq.answer: 上游说明支持范围会随构建变化，启用 cgo 的发行二进制能解析比纯 Go 构建更多的代码语言。

faq.question: 哪些版本使用 Apache-2.0？
faq.answer: 仓库从 3.0.0 起采用 Apache-2.0。早期发行版保留当时的条款，单独托管的 Caveman Cloud 适用其商业条款。

en.seoTitle: Context Mode: Local Tool Output Indexing for Coding Agents
en.seoDescription: Context Mode keeps long tool outputs in a local SQLite index and retrieves excerpts on demand. Check MCP and hook support, plus the source-available ELv2 terms.
en.description: Context Mode keeps large tool outputs in a local SQLite index so a coding agent can retrieve the relevant lines instead of reading the entire result.
en.overviewTitle: How Context Mode handles large tool outputs
overview: A full test log can fill an agent’s context while the useful evidence occupies only a few lines. Context Mode runs work in its local execution environment, keeps results in a SQLite FTS5 index and returns focused results or search excerpts.

MCP provides the tool interface. Host hooks and rules can steer compatible agents toward those tools, and continuity features vary by host. Read the platform guide for the agent you actually use and check what gets written to the local index before feeding it confidential material.

The local plugin is source-available under Elastic License 2.0. Context Mode Gateway is a separate hosted service. To borrow this pattern in Floatboat, keep raw evidence on disk and return compact references with enough context to verify a decision.
en.capabilitiesTitle: Context Mode’s execution and search tools
en.capabilitiesIntro: Long outputs can stay searchable even when only a few lines go back to the model. Review which tool outputs are indexed and how the agent retrieves details.

capabilities.title: Local execution
capabilities.description: Run a command or script and return a focused result while preserving output for later lookup.

capabilities.title: SQLite full-text search
capabilities.description: Retrieve passages from indexed tool results with an exact error string, test name or source identifier.

capabilities.title: Host-specific routing
capabilities.description: Review MCP and hook support for your agent before expecting automatic routing or session recovery.

useCases.title: Context Mode use cases
useCases.description: Pick a noisy workflow and compare the evidence reaching the model. Track both the amount retrieved and whether it is enough to resolve the task.

items.title: Find failing tests in a long run
items.description: Return the failed test names and first errors to the agent. Search the saved output for an assertion and its surrounding stack when the first result is insufficient.

items.title: Review a batch of fetched pages
items.description: Index the fetch results under distinct source names. Retrieve only excerpts relevant to the question and preserve a link back to each original source.

items.title: Summarize a noisy build
items.description: Group errors by compiler message or file before handing them to the model. Keep the full log available to check whether different symptoms share a cause.

items.title: Resume a long investigation
items.description: On a host with continuity support, test whether the agent can recover previous decisions after compaction. Check the restored summary against a short reference before relying on it.

prerequisites.title: What to check before installing Context Mode
prerequisites.description: The local plugin and the hosted Gateway have separate setup and data flows. For a pilot, choose a supported host and use a test project whose outputs can be indexed safely.

items.title: Supported host
items.description: Check which MCP tools, hooks and recovery features are available for your agent version.

items.title: Local data scope
items.description: Review what the index retains, where it is stored and how to remove test data when the pilot ends.

items.title: License and deployment
items.description: Review ELv2, especially the restrictions on offering the software as a managed service.

faq.question: Does Context Mode shorten the agent’s replies?
faq.answer: Its main optimization is on the input side: large tool results are kept out of the active context until requested.

faq.question: Is the plugin open source?
faq.answer: The repository is source-available under Elastic License 2.0, which restricts certain uses such as offering its features as a managed service.

faq.question: Is the local plugin the same as Gateway?
faq.answer: Gateway is a separate hosted service. Check its request routing and retention terms independently of the local plugin.

faq.question: Do all agent hosts offer the same hooks?
faq.answer: Support varies by host. Check the platform documentation for routing, capture and session restoration.

faq.question: Do the upstream byte benchmarks predict my token usage?
faq.answer: They describe particular workloads and units. Measure tokens or cost separately for the task, model and host you use.

faq.question: Can I inspect an excerpt in context?
faq.answer: Search the stored output by a source name, error message or test identifier, then retrieve surrounding lines when the excerpt is too narrow.

zh.seoTitle: Context Mode：用本地索引减少 Agent 上下文中的工具输出
zh.seoDescription: Context Mode 把长日志和其他工具输出留在本地 SQLite 索引里，Agent 按需取回片段。试用前可核对 MCP 与钩子支持，并区分 ELv2 本地插件和托管 Gateway。
zh.description: Context Mode 把大体积工具输出留在本地 SQLite 索引中，让编程 Agent 按需取回相关内容。
zh.overviewTitle: Context Mode 如何处理大体积工具输出
overview: 完整的测试日志可能占满 Agent 上下文，而定位错误只需要其中几行。Context Mode 在本地执行命令，用 SQLite FTS5 保存工具结果，向模型返回经过筛选的结果或检索片段。
插件通过 MCP 提供工具，支持的宿主还可以用钩子和规则引导 Agent 选用这些工具。自动路由和会话恢复因宿主而异。在处理敏感资料前，先核对实际索引会保留什么。
本地插件的源码采用 Elastic License 2.0，Context Mode Gateway 则是独立的托管服务。在 Floatboat 里可以借鉴按需取证的方式，把完整日志留在文件中，只把必要片段和可追查的位置带进对话。
zh.capabilitiesTitle: Context Mode 的本地执行与检索能力
zh.capabilitiesIntro: 让长日志留在本地索引，需要时按错误文本、测试名称或来源定位片段。先用一条已知错误核对检索结果，确认必要的上下文仍能找回。

capabilities.title: 本地执行
capabilities.description: 运行命令或脚本，把结果保存供后续检索，同时只返回当前需要的信息。

capabilities.title: SQLite 全文检索
capabilities.description: 按错误文本、测试名称或来源标识定位工具输出中的相关片段。

capabilities.title: 宿主路由
capabilities.description: 核对实际 Agent 的 MCP 和钩子支持，再决定是否启用自动路由或会话恢复。

useCases.title: Context Mode 的使用场景
useCases.description: 选一个工具输出很长的任务，对照处理前后进入模型的内容。除了看字节和 Token，也用同一条复现步骤检查检索片段是否足以解释故障。

items.title: 定位测试日志中的失败
items.description: 先将失败用例名和首条错误返回给 Agent。初步信息不够时，检索断言文本及相关调用栈，避免把整个测试输出复制进对话。

items.title: 从多份网页抓取结果取证
items.description: 用不同来源名称保存抓取结果，按问题检索相关段落。每段都保留原始出处，方便在结果有冲突时回到页面核对。

items.title: 归类构建中的重复错误
items.description: 先按编译器消息或文件聚合故障，再把各组代表性错误交给 Agent。保留原始日志，以便检查几个表面不同的症状是否指向同一原因。

items.title: 恢复长时间排查的线索
items.description: 如果宿主支持恢复，测试上下文压缩后是否找得回已确认的决定与未解决问题。先与人工记录核对，再用于更长的任务。

prerequisites.title: 使用 Context Mode 前的检查
prerequisites.description: 本地插件与托管 Gateway 的配置和数据流不同。试用时先核对宿主的 MCP 与钩子支持，再选一个允许把工具输出存入本地索引的测试项目。

items.title: 宿主支持
items.description: 确认所用 Agent 版本支持哪些 MCP 工具、钩子与恢复能力。

items.title: 本地数据范围
items.description: 核对索引保留什么、写到哪里，以及试用结束后如何清理。

items.title: 许可和部署方式
items.description: 阅读 ELv2 条款，尤其是向他人提供托管服务的限制。

faq.question: Context Mode 会缩短 Agent 的回复吗？
faq.answer: 它主要减少进入上下文的工具输出。回复长度还取决于任务要求和 Agent 自己的表达方式。

faq.question: 这个插件是开源的吗？
faq.answer: 当前仓库采用 Elastic License 2.0，属于源码可见软件，并对将功能作为托管服务提供等用途有限制。

faq.question: 本地插件和 Gateway 有什么区别？
faq.answer: Gateway 是单独的托管服务，拥有自己的账户和请求路径。数据保留条款需要与本地插件分开核对。

faq.question: 每个 Agent 的钩子功能都一样吗？
faq.answer: 不一样。自动路由、捕获和会话恢复都要按宿主版本查阅上游支持表。

faq.question: 上游字节缩减数据等同于 Token 消耗吗？
faq.answer: 它只描述指定测试条件下的输出量变化。实际 Token 或账单应在所用模型、宿主和任务上单独测量。

faq.question: 检索片段太短怎么办？
faq.answer: 按来源名、错误文本或测试标识找回周边行，让结论可以回到完整工具输出复核。
